battlefield-frieze-with-contacting-caval.description: A wide etched landscape band of a battle. At the right a mass of cavalry charges to the left under raised lances and pennants, horses rearing over fallen men; at the left scattered foot soldiers and skirmishing riders fight across open ground; clouds of gun smoke drift above both halves and a tree closes each end. Dark brown-black ink with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the figures and the ground; the sky and everything outside the drawn edge are transparent.

courting-landscape-with-flock-and-town.description: A long horizontal landscape frieze. At the left a seated woman and a standing man in a plumed hat clasp hands under a tree, each holding a tall staff, with a dog and a grazing flock beside them; across the open middle ground stand six more courting pairs, one woman holding a man by his long hat plume, with a leafy tree behind them; at the right a flock of birds flies over a hilltop town with towers and a wind-blown shrub closes the scene. Streaky clouds above, hatched ground and reclining figures below. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.

stag-hunt-with-three-mounted-hunters.description: A wide etched landscape band of a stag hunt running from right to left. A stag leaps left at the left of centre with a hound at its heels; two mounted hunters gallop after it across open ground and a third on a rearing horse in the right foreground raises a long thin rod; two more hounds race between them. Bushes and trees close each end, a town with towers sits on the horizon and layered clouds fill the sky. Dark brown-black ink with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the ground and figures; the sky and the outside of the band are transparent.

usage_notes: Use once as a horizontal header or footer band; it does not repeat.
The three hunters, the stag with its hound and the two other hounds are also cut out as separate pieces, so the hunt can be recomposed at any width.

tall-flowering-stem-with-serrated-leaves.description: A tall upright stem with pairs of broad serrated oval leaves, whorls of tubular two-lipped flowers springing from the leaf axils and a spike of small flowers at the top; the stem is cut square at the foot. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

tall-flowering-stem-with-serrated-leaves.quality: The stem is cut square at the foot, as on the plate.
tall-flowering-stem-with-serrated-leaves.title: Flowering stem with tubular flowers and paired serrated leaves

two-open-flowers-on-pointed-basal-leaves.description: Two open five-petalled flowers, one at the left facing the viewer with a star-shaped centre and one at the right turned three-quarters, above a fan of long pointed lance leaves spreading from a single foot, with one bud between them. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

two-open-flowers-on-pointed-basal-leaves.title: Two open flowers over a fan of pointed leaves

two-star-flowers-on-curving-leafy-stem.description: A slender stem rises past one long folded leaf, bends over at the top and ends in a drooping flower in a papery sheath pointing right; a side stalk carries an open six-petalled star flower with a central cup facing the viewer. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

two-star-flowers-on-curving-leafy-stem.title: Narcissus with a nodding bud on a curving stem

two-touching-rose-stalks-with-drooping-s.description: Two prickly rose stalks whose stems cross: an open double rose at the top seen face on with a small centre of stamens, a second open rose at the lower right seen from the side, a drooping bud with long pointed sepals at the right, and serrated rose leaves in threes and fives at the left and along the stems. Fine etched hatching; dark brown ink on a transparent background.
